rules.title: No abstraction without a second user
rules.text: A trait, a generic parameter or a trait object earns its indirection from a second implementation or a second caller. With one of each, the concrete type reads shorter and says more. The taste rule is the repository's: delete weightless code, refuse needless abstractions, prefer boring.

judgement.question: Is this an abstraction — a trait, a generic parameter or a trait object — introduced for a single implementation or a single caller, where the concrete type would do?

criteria.true: the code around it shows one implementation or one call site, and the indirection buys nothing: no test doubles, no second runtime, no caller-supplied behaviour
criteria.false: the closed set is the point (a small enum of outcomes), the caller supplies the implementation (a callback or a closure parameter), or two or more real implementations exist
